facts.fact: Gemma 偷看了初见全程，滑进座位就起哄说 Eden 摊上全宇宙最可爱的家教。
facts.anchor: Oh my god. I think you have the cutest tutor ever!

facts.fact: Eden 反复划线：与 Oliver 的关系必须严格限于职业，不许有半点旖旎。
facts.anchor: our relationship has to be strictly professional

facts.fact: Oliver 短信回复「本周只是课程介绍」，末尾带了个眨眼表情，还劝她先读本书。
facts.anchor: But maybe reading a book would be a good start ;)

facts.fact: Gemma 断言：让他推荐书是「试探水位」——看她吃不吃言情这一套。
facts.anchor: Testing the waters, you know. Seeing what you’re into.

facts.fact: Eden 吐槽被安利的书：一百页无情节无人物，读得「生理性痛苦」。
facts.anchor: I fail to understand how one can write a book with no plot.

facts.fact: 图书馆争吵中 Oliver 拍案：是你亲口雇的我，想及格就需要我，学校逼你修这门课不关我事。
facts.anchor: You literally hired me! And you certainly will if you want to pass! It’s not my fault the university’s making you do this subject!

facts.fact: 争吵让两人贴近到看清鼻梁上的雀斑，Eden 冒出「伸手就吻」的冲动。
facts.anchor: He’s so close that I can make out a smattering of freckles across his nose. So close I could just grab his face and kiss him.

facts.fact: 辅导收尾后 Oliver 挤出僵硬的笑、头也不回地走了，Eden 不愿承认有多刺痛。
facts.anchor: He gives me a tight smile and then walks away without a backwards glance.
